notes.note: Pickett did have 24 disposals but at just 58%. His lowest return since their bye.
Picket was the best scorer for the Demons with his 27 disposals and 2 goals. Back to back over 100 for the first time since rounds 13 and 14.
Pickett had a goal from his 20 touches.  He has been under and over 100 in alternating weeks over the last 6 rounds.
Pickett was hot early with 37 in the first term but after that he had the Mullin tag applied and he had 37 for the rest of the game as he finished with 14 touches and a goal.
Pickett was one of the stars for the Demons with 29 touches 7 marks and a goal. This was his best score for the last four weeks as he looked very active around the packs.
Pickett had 21 touches but didn't kick any goals. But he still had a solid impact on the game helping him to the 93.
Good bounce back from Pickett after last week's down score. 25 disposals and 7 clearances for him as he didn't have any major scoreboard impact.
Pickett was quiet as he had a tag from Peatling and was held to just the 15 disposals.
Pickett had his best score of the season so far with his 32 disposals and 3 goals. Just wait until after his bye though.
A winning goal certainly helped boost Pickett's score. He ended the game with 3 goals and 28 disposals. He does have the tricky R16 bye so you may want to wait til after that to bring him in.
Pickett did get some attention from Bedford during the game and had his third sub 75 score in the last four games which is a real concern for owners.
Pickett put those two poor scores behind him and was one of four Demons over 100 this week. 25 disposals 9 tackles and 6 clearances was a great outcome. He will be a popular trade in again.

Pickett copped the tag from Maginness and it hurt him with just 13 disposals but it was the 2 goals that did help his scoring. This is now two sub 100 in a row for the first time since the opening two rounds of the season.
Pickett had a tag from Hough after half time and he had his lowest for the season. He escaped suspension for the incident with Waterman and should be fine this week.
Pickett got the Jordon tag as expected but he still managed a couple of goals from 22 disposals and he led the team with 8 clearances.
Pickett was outstanding with 4 goals the result of 27 kicks and 2 handballs. He has been a popular trade in over recent weeks and will be one of the top two or three forwards.

Kossie has been a popular trade in over recent weeks and this week he delivered again. He is definitely a good option for your forward line but his BE is over 120 however he is up against Richmond so could hit that score.
8 tackles and 2 goals to go with his 28 disposals for Pickett. Despite not reaching 100 due to 3 free kicks against he was still the third highest scorer for his team.
Kossie Pickett was great again in the second half helping to set up the win for the Dees. He should be high on our list of trade ins for the forward line the way he is going.

Kossie Pickett really pulled one out of the bag and was the catalyst for the Demons comeback with his 33 disposals and 7 marks. His score was elevated by the fact he helped to turn the tide of the game.
Pickett has had a low score again this week and is likely to drop in value after his third round.
